summary: Unified and closed out the removed-leader question on the retained control execution. CheckRun e17ebb2095714b6289c41dc4e029e3d4 (fixed experiment 425ee562e1dc40a2928df98330de575c-experiment, version 3) parsed eleven events with no loss: the single-voter scenario repeats its violated witness (parsed index 3), the actual leader still answers correctly (index 4) and the removed leader repeats the stale index after heartbeat intervals (index 5), while the two-voter control holds for 'no answer' (index 9: read_states 0, read_answered false) and its unconfirmed-read comparisons are violated (index 9: unconfirmed_reads 1 after a hidden readOnly round carrying a read context; index 10: still unanswered after three further heartbeat intervals). Change in the account: the question now covers both shapes of the same removed-leader state - a ReadIndex path that never consults membership, answering instantly from the frozen commit index when the reduced configuration has a single voter (stale, unconfirmed, no message sent) and accepting a request it can never confirm when it has two voters (no answer, no refusal) - with the control showing the failure depends on the answering node not being the configuration's voter, and with the general stale-leader caveat, the documented client retry allowance and the exercised configuration held as counterevidence. Conclusion violated, defect_claim asserted, knowledge revisions 1 cited, limitations kept (StepDownOnRemoval false, contract-level witness without a state machine, forwarded/lease-based routes and CheckQuorum-enabled windows unmeasured). The question record was refined to that form and its discriminator replaced with the remaining unmeasured routes; no new execution was requested.
